attributes.name: Kaven Windstrike
attributes.powers:
If you are the only character at this location the difficulty to defeat Kaven is increased by 2.

If undefeated, instead of normal damage, Kaven deals 1d4 Combat damage to you; banish this card.

If defeated, you may immediately attempt to close this location.
